_doc: TWO SEPARATE LISTS, deliberately in one file so the distinction is visible to whoever edits it (Cybered, card 87d7c86f). trustedPublishers decides what may be INSTALLED without an explicit operator confirmation -- it is a security control and changes to it deserve a security review. relevantFamilies and relevanceKeywords decide what is shown as a CODING model -- that is a cheap data edit and is expected to change often. Do not merge them: a list that must stay easy to refresh must not also be the thing that gates installation.
